self-h4-gfn2.title: Self-authored rigid H2-pair illustrative model
self-h4-gfn2.electronicMethod: GFN2-xTB, gas phase, fixed single point, GNU/OpenBLAS isolated candidate reporting 6.7.0
self-h4-gfn2.identity: Own formula-defined illustrative model, not an optimized or experimental hydrogen cluster. Native electron/charge readback and independent density/orbital normalization checks passed.

self-h14-hirshfeld.title: Self-authored H14 finite cluster with central H2 target
self-h14-hirshfeld.construction: Seven rigid H2 molecules aligned along X, each with bond .74 Angstrom: one centered at the origin and six centered at +/-X, +/-Y and +/-Z at 2.8 Angstrom.
self-h14-hirshfeld.method: Existing Multiwfn/native finite-cluster Hirshfeld-weight 0.5 surface and standard dnorm, explicit .15 Bohr grid; closed surface verified
self-h14-hirshfeld.identity: Own illustrative finite geometry, not a crystal or an optimized cluster. No external PDB/CIF or quantum wavefunction used.
